site.title: Info Feux Gironde
site.tagline: Citizen archive: official sources after the Gironde wildfires.
meta.description: Info Feux Gironde is an independent citizen archive. It points to official pages (préfecture, attestations, insurance claims) and does not publish live fire figures.
banner.unofficial: Independent citizen initiative — not run by the State, emergency services or a local authority. In danger, follow FR-Alert and préfecture instructions.
banner.infoMayChange: Information can change quickly. Always confirm urgent instructions via FR-Alert, emergency services and official authorities.

footer.howWeVerify.body: Every fact shown here comes from a cited official source, with the date we checked that source. If we cannot confirm something with an official source, we link to the source that may confirm it rather than showing it as certain.

about.title: About Info Feux Gironde
about.body1: Info Feux Gironde is an independent citizen initiative created during the Gironde wildfire emergency. Its purpose is to make official information easier to find and understand, especially for residents and visitors who may face a language barrier.
about.body2: This site is now a navigation archive: it points to official pages (préfecture, FR-Alert, Métropole) and does not replace emergency services or authorities. It no longer publishes a live fire situation.
about.body3: Authorities and organisations are welcome to suggest corrections, preferred wording, or additional resources.
